extracted.name: Shokupan The Fluffy Japanese White Loaf 2lb Bread machine
extracted.description: By just adding ingredients into the bread machine, you can make a fluffy and light-textured bread like in asian bakeries.
instruction_lines: Put all ingredients into the bread pan in the exact order. Yeast shoud not touch water.
Select White Bread program, crust color of your choice, and 2lb size. Then start.
Once it's done, remove bread from the pan.
Allow the loaf to cool on a wire rack for 30mins pnrior to slicing.
